newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea Jan-March shipbuilding orders up 166.7 pct.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea Jan-March shipbuilding orders up 166.7 pct.

text.p: Shipbuilding orders won by South Korean companies during the first three months of this year rose 166.7 percent to 1.67 million gross tons from 627,600 gross tons a year earlier, the Korea Shipbuilders' Association said on Thursday.
An official at the association said export orders accounted for almost all of the total, but gave no breakdown between domestic and overseas orders.
As of the end of March, South Korean companies had backlog orders for 273 vessels amounting to 13.46 million gross tons, compared with 12.87 million in 287 vessels a year earlier.
